svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 220 x 140 mm from 3 mm 6061 plate; square, deburr, corners left square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark from the far end (opposite the sockets) and the socket side;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the floor holes picture gives every position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet nut holes 9.0 mm at 20 and 200 from the far end, 20 and 120

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the socket side (the 180 x 100 mounting pattern).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner screw holes 4.5 mm, 7.5 from each edge; countersink from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below to 8.4 mm so the M4 heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tapped holes through the plate: M3 (2.5 drill) for the controller (4)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the supervisor standoffs (4); M4 (3.3 drill) for the contactor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the tube sits on its top face on a film of thermally conductive

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sealant; four M4 countersunk screws go up into the corner ports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the tube on it; the four corner holes line up with the ports.
